description: Shared Renovate preset for the chri5bot, cybergarden-team and TechDevStudio repositories. Low-noise defaults: one weekly grouped PR for non-major updates, majors behind Dependency Dashboard approval, no automerge while CI runs locally.

packageRules.description: Major updates are listed on the Dependency Dashboard and only get a PR once approved there.
GitHub Actions bumps are grouped on their own so a workflow change never mixes with runtime dependencies.
Majors that must move together (vite 8 needed @vitejs/plugin-react 6 in the same PR, orbit-box 2026-10) form one group.
Formatters and linters are pinned exactly: a caret range on Biome changed what it formats in a lockfile PR (licita #38, platform #21).
Every Bun pin (setup-bun steps, reusable-workflow inputs, packageManager) moves in one PR (platform #20).

customManagers.description: bun-version passed as an input to a reusable workflow (`uses: .../.github/workflows/x.yml` with `bun-version: "x.y.z"`): the bun manager only reads oven-sh/setup-bun steps (platform #20). Assumes the usual 2-space YAML: the input lines sit 4+ spaces deep, so the match stops at the next job key.
